findings.issue: Port-only readiness accepts a foreign listener appearing during search-index generation, releasing tests before the owned server starts. reuseExistingServer:false checks only before spawning; serve can also switch ports. A deterministic regression reproduced this wrong-source acceptance.

summary: Fixed one medium severity server-isolation race by waiting for the owned Python HTTP server to announce a successful bind instead of polling a shared port. The regression failed before the fix and passes afterward; validation passed 57 Playwright, 400 Python and 28 Node tests (all exit 0). Product source and question data are unchanged; no push or remote CI was performed.
